text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Review is recommending the implementation of parking regulations and stop control for the development at 36 and 37 Jane Osler Boulevard (Allegrezza Court). Allegrezza Court has been dedicated as a public road but has not been assumed by the City of Toronto. Currently there are no traffic or parking regulations on this street. The proposed parking and traffic regulations are consistent with City policies and guidelines given the surrounding residential nature.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on both sides of Allegrezza Court between Jane Osler Boulevard and the west end of Allegrezza Court. 2. Authorized a compulsory stop for eastbound traffic on Allegrezza Court at Jane Osler Boulevard.
